text:
pagerbot: ALERT: GPU pool 'hosted-gpu-eu' saturating, queue growth detected, autoscaler failing to apply scale-up (severity: P2). Metric spike at 3893021108. Paging @maria (oncall). :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): On it. seeing queue length ~18k requests, 95-99% GPU util on 8/8 nodes. Any errors from the scaler?

alex (runtime): Logs show repeated errors from autoscaler: `scale-controller: failed to acquire cluster lock` and `scale-request rejected: max_replicas=8 reached`. Pool config max_replicas was unintentionally set to 8 after last week rollout.

kai (infra): I can temporarily increase pool cap, but need approval. Also seeing continuous-batching params were changed in rollout #2026-03-10: `batch_window_ms: 80 -> 200`, `continuous_enabled: true` — that can increase latency and reduce throughput for short requests.

sam (support): Customer impact: error-rate for /generate up 12% for EU region, several customer tickets from enterprise accounts reporting timeouts >20s. Notifications sent to affected accounts, awaiting status updates.

emily (product): Can we prioritize reducing customer-facing errors? If scale cap bump is fast, do that first. Rollback batching change if it helps.

maria (oncall): Plan: 1) bump pool max_replicas to 16 (temp), 2) roll back continuous-batching params to previous stable, 3) adjust prefix cache TTL/rehit policy, 4) monitor 15m. Who can run the cap bump now?

kai (infra): I can do the cap bump in ~2 min. Will patch autoscaler config and create a short-lived feature flag. Running: ```kubectl apply -f gpu-pool-hosted-eu-cap.yaml --record
# patch: spec.maxReplicas: 16```

maria (oncall): Confirming - deploying now. Alex, start preparing rollback for batching change, include config diff and validation steps.

alex (runtime): I have the rollback ready. Diff: ```- continuous_enabled: true
- batch_window_ms: 200
+ continuous_enabled: false
+ batch_window_ms: 80``` 
I'll push to runtime-configs/stable and trigger canary off. Need approval to force rollback immediately (this will affect throughput but seems necessary).

sam (support): If we rollback batching, some customers on high-throughput short prompts may see better latency but throughput per GPU may drop. I'll flag the enterprise tickets: possible short-term increased cost.

maria (oncall): Approve immediate rollback and cap bump. Do both in parallel. Kai, confirm autoscaler patched. Alex, apply rollback and restart runtime pods gracefully (drain -> restart).

kai (infra): Autoscaler patch applied. New maxReplicas=16. Metrics: queue length dropping from 18k -> 10.4k within 2 min. GPU util still ~92%.

deploy-bot: rollout complete for autoscaler config at 3893021230, status: success.

alex (runtime): Rolling back batching now. Command: `gctl apply runtime-config --env=hosted-eu --file=batching-rollback.yaml` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-hosted-eu`. Doing graceful drains.

maria (oncall): Note: we should also investigate prefix cache miss rates — dashboard shows prefix_cache_hit_rate fell from 0.87 -> 0.34 starting 3892950000 (coincides with recent prefix TTL tweak). If eviction policy changed, it could cause KV cache misses and extra compute per request.

alex (runtime): Good catch. Current prefix cache TTL is 30s after last deploy; previous was 300s. Rollback will set TTL back to 300s. I'll update `cache/prefix-config` as part of the runtime change.

sam (support): Customer-facing metrics: 503s and timeouts down by ~60% after autoscaler bump and rollback started. Sending interim status: "Mitigation in progress — scaling cap increased and batching config rolled back; impact reduced, continuing monitoring."

emily (product): Keep me posted. Prioritize stable baseline for next 24h. We'll need a postmortem and revert the rollout process that changed multiple runtime and infra knobs together.

kai (infra): Monitoring after rollback: queue 10.4k -> 3.2k in 6 minutes. GPU util normalized to 72-78%. prefix_cache_hit_rate climbing back to 0.80 after TTL restore.

maria (oncall): Closing the immediate pager: mitigation succeeded. Action items: - Incident writeup (maria) - Postmortem with rollout gating + better preflight checks (alex & kai) - Customer follow-ups (sam & emily) - Add autoscaler safety to block accidental maxReplicas small values (kai) - Add synthetic tests to catch prefix cache TTL regressions (alex).

sam (support): Sent follow-up emails to affected customers. No major escalations.

maria (oncall): FINAL note: severity downgraded to P3 at 3893021829. Leaving thread open for postmortem drafts. :white_check_mark:
